description: Sourced parts for formal meetings and floor debate, mined from the Congressional Record (public domain). Each text is a speaker's first sentence as recorded, with the address to the presiding officer replaced by a slot.

slots.chair: How the speaker addresses the presiding officer, such as Madam Speaker, Mr. President or Madam Chair.

mining.daysRead: 63 Congressional Record days, June 2 to December 18, 2025, House and Senate pages
